verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Alif-laam-raa kitaabun anzalnaahu ilayka litukhrijan-naasa minaz-zulumaati ilan-noor bi-idhni rabbihim ilaa siraatil-azeezil-hameed
Allaahil-ladhee lahu maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi wa waylun lilkaafireena min adhaabin shadeed
Al-ladheena yastahibboonal-hayaatad-dunyaa alal-aakhirati wa yasuddoona an sabeelillaahi wa yabghoonahaa iwajan ulaa'ika fee dalaalin ba'eed
Wa maa arsalnaa min rasoolin illaa bilisaani qawmihi liyubayyina lahum fayudillu Allaahu man yashaa'u wa yahdee man yashaa'u wa huwal-azeezul-hakeem
Wa laqad arsalnaa moosaa bi-aayaatinaa an akhrij qawmaka minaz-zulumaati ilan-noori wa dhakkirhum bi-ayyaami Allaahi inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin likulli sabbaarin shakoor

Wa idh qaala moosaa liqawmihi udhkuroo ni'matallaahi alaykum idh anjaakum min aali fir'awna yasoomoonakum soo'al-adhaabi wa yudhabbihoona abnaa'akum wa yastahyoona nisaa'akum wa fee dhaalikum balaa'un min rabbikum azeem
Wa idh ta'adhdhana rabbukum la-in shakartum la-azeedannakum wa la-in kafartum inna adhaabee lashadeed
Wa qaala moosaa in takfuroo antum wa man fil-ardi jamee'an fa-innallaaha laghaniyyun hameed

Alam ya'tikum naba'ul-ladheena min qablikum qawmi noohin wa aadin wa thamooda wal-ladheena min ba'dihim laa ya'lamuhum illaa Allaahu jaa'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyinaati faraddoo aydiyahum fee afwaahihim wa qaaloo innaa kafarnaa bimaa ursiltum bihi wa innaa lafee shakkin mimmaa tad'oonanaa ilayhi mureeb

Qaalat rusuluhum afee Allaahi shakkun faatiris-samaawaati wal-ardi yad'ookum liyaghfira lakum min dhunoobikum wa yu'uakhkhirakum ilaa ajalin musamman qaaloo in antum illaa basharun mithlunaa tureedoona an tasuddoonaa ammaa kaana ya'budu aabaa'uunaa fa'toonaa bisultaanin mubeen

Qaalat lahum rusuluhum in nahnu illaa basharun mithlukum wa laakinna Allaaha yamunnu alaa man yashaa'u min ibaadihi wa maa kaana lanaa an na'tiyakum bisultaanin illaa bi-idhni Allaahi wa alaa Allaahi falyatawakkalil-mu'minoon
Wa maa lanaa allaa natawakkala alaa Allaahi wa qad hadaanaa subulanaa wa lanasbiranna alaa maa aadhaytumoonaa wa alaa Allaahi falyatawakkalil-mutawakkiloon
Wa qaalal-ladheena kafaroo lirusulihim lanukhrijannakum min ardinaa aw lata'oodunna fee millatinaa fa-awhaa ilayhim rabbuhum lanuhlikannaz-zaalimeen
Wa lanuskinannakumul-arda min ba'dihim dhaalika liman khaafa maqaamee wa khaafa wa-eed
Wastaftahoo wa khaaba kullu jabbaarin aneed
Min waraa'ihi jahannamu wa yusqaa min maa'in sadeed
Yatajarra'uhu wa laa yakaadu yuseeghuhu wa ya'teehil-mawtu min kulli makaanin wa maa huwa bimayyitin wa min waraa'ihi adhaabun ghaleez
Mathalul-ladheena kafaroo birabbihim a'maaluhum karamaadin ishtaddat bihir-reehu fee yawmin aasifin laa yaqdiroona mimmaa kasaboo alaa shay'in dhaalika huwad-dalaalul-ba'eed
Alam taraa annallaaha khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda bil-haqqi in yasha yudhhibkum wa ya'ti bikhalqin jadeed
Wa maa dhaalika alaa Allaahi bi-azeez

Wa barazoo Lillaahi jamee'an faqaalad-du'afaa'u lilladheena istakbaroo innaa kunnaa lakum taba'an fahal antum mughnoona annaa min adhaabi Allaahi min shay'in qaaloo law hadaanaa Allaahu lahadaynaakum sawaa'un alaynaa ajazi'naa am sabarnaa maa lanaa min mahees

Wa qaalash-shaytaanu lammaa qudiyal-amru innallaaha wa-adakum wa'dal-haqqi wa wa-adtukum fa-akhlaftukum wa maa kaana lee alaykum min sultaanin illaa an da'awtukum fastajabtum lee falaa taloomoonee wa loomoo anfusakum maa anaa bimusrikhikum wa maa antum bimusrikhiyya innee kafartu bimaa ashraktumoonee min qablu innaz-zaalimeena lahum adhaabun aleem
Wa udkhilal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa bi-idhni rabbihim tahiyyatuhum feehaa salaam
Alam taraa kayfa daraba Allaahu mathalan kalimatan tayyibatan kashajaratin tayyibatin asluhaa thaabitun wa far'uhaa fis-samaa
Tu'tee ukulahaa kulla heenin bi-idhni rabbihaa wa yadribu Allaahul-amthaala lin-naasi la-allahum yatadhakkaroon
Wa mathalu kalimatin khabeethatin kashajaratin khabeethatin ujtuththat min fawqil-ardi maa lahaa min qaraar
Yuthabbitu Allaahul-ladheena aamanoo bil-qawlith-thaabiti fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wa fil-aakhirati wa yudillu Allaahuz-zaalimeena wa yaf'alu Allaahu maa yashaa
Alam taraa ilal-ladheena baddaloo ni'matallaahi kufran wa ahalloo qawmahum daaral-bawaar
Jahannama yaslawnahaa wa bi'sal-qaraar
Wa ja'aloo Lillaahi andaadan liyudilloo an sabeelihi qul tamatta'oo fa-inna maseerakum ilan-naar
Qul li-ibaadiyal-ladheena aamanoo yuqeemus-salaata wa yunfiqoo mimmaa razaqnaahum sirran wa alaaniyatan min qabli an ya'tiya yawmun laa bay'un feehi wa laa khilaal

Allaahul-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda wa anzala minas-samaa'i maa'an fa-akhraja bihi minath-thamaraati rizqan lakum wa sakhkhara lakumul-fulka litajriya fil-bahri bi-amrihi wa sakhkhara lakumul-anhaar
Wa sakhkhara lakumush-shamsa wal-qamara daa'ibayni wa sakhkhara lakumul-layla wan-nahaar
Wa aataakum min kulli maa sa'altumoohu wa in ta'uddoo ni'matallaahi laa tuhsoohaa innal-insaana lazaloomun kaffaar
Wa idh qaala ibraaheemu rabbi ij'al haadhal-balada aaminan wajnubnee wa baniyya an na'budal-asnaam
Rabbi innahunna adlalna katheeran minan-naasi faman tabi'anee fa-innahu minnee wa man asaanee fa-innaka ghafoorun Raheem

Rabbanaa innee askantu min dhurriyyatee biwaadin ghayri dhee zar'in inda baytikal-muharrami rabbanaa liyuqeemus-salaata faaj'al af'idatan minan-naasi tahwee ilayhim warzuqhum minath-thamaraati la-allahum yashkuroon
Rabbanaa innaka ta'lamu maa nukhfee wa maa nu'linu wa maa yakhfaa alaa Allaahi min shay'in fil-ardi wa laa fis-samaa
Al-hamdu Lillaahil-ladhee wahaba lee alal-kibari ismaa'eela wa ishaaqa inna rabbee lasamee'ud-du'aa
Rabbi ij'alnee muqeemas-salaati wa min dhurriyyatee rabbanaa wa taqabbal du'aa
Rabbanaa ighfir lee wa liwaalidayya wa lilmu'mineena yawma yaqoomul-hisaab
Wa laa tahsabanna Allaaha ghaafilan ammaa ya'maluz-zaalimoona innamaa yu'uakhkhiruhum liyawmin tashkhasu feehil-absaar
Muhti'eena muqni'ee ru'oosihim laa yartaddu ilayhim tarfuhum wa af'idatuhum hawaa

Wa andhirin-naasa yawma ya'teehimul-adhaabu fayaqoolul-ladheena zalamoo rabbanaa akhkhirnaa ilaa ajalin qareebin nujib da'wataka wa nattabi'ir-rusula awalam takoonoo aqsamtum min qablu maa lakum min zawaal
Wa sakantum fee masaakinil-ladheena zalamoo anfusahum wa tabayyana lakum kayfa fa-alnaa bihim wa darabnaa lakumul-amthaal
Wa qad makaroo makrahum wa indallaahi makruhum wa in kaana makruhum litazoola minhul-jibaal
Falaa tahsabanna Allaaha mukhlifa wa'dihi rusulahu innallaaha azeezun dhun-tiqaam
Yawma tubaddalul-ardu ghayral-ardi was-samaawaatu wa barazoo Lillaahil-waahidil-qahhaar
Wa taral-mujrimeena yawma'idhin muqarraneena fil-asfaad
Saraabeeluhum min qatiraanin wa taghshaa wujoohahumun-naar
Liyajziya Allaahu kulla nafsin maa kasabat innallaaha saree'ul-hisaab
Haadhaa balaaghun lin-naasi wa liyundharoo bihi wa liya'lamoo annamaa huwa ilaahun waahidun wa liyadhdhakkara ulul-albaab
